nodes.title: **Key Features**
nodes.summary: Key features include flexible loan amounts from ₹25,000 up to ₹50 lakhs (or local equivalent), competitive and affordable interest rates, seasonal EMI or bullet repayment options, fast-tracked disbursement, no prepayment penalty, secured or partially secured collateral options, and an extra 1% interest discount for women-led agri ventures.

nodes.title: **Who Can Apply?**
nodes.summary: Eligible applicants include individual farmers, joint landholders, Self Help Groups (SHGs), agribusinesses, and cooperatives.

nodes.title: **Documents Required**
nodes.summary: Required documents are identity proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Passport, etc.), address proof, land ownership or lease documents, recent passport-sized photographs, an optional Kisan Credit Card, and quotations or invoices for equipment where applicable.

nodes.title: **How to Apply?**
nodes.summary: Applications can be submitted three ways: online through the ZX Bank Asia mobile app (recommended), by visiting a branch or digital kiosk, or by contacting customer care.

children.title: **1. Online Application (Recommended)**
children.summary: Apply online by downloading the ZX Bank Asia mobile app, logging in or registering with mobile number and e-KYC, opening Loans > Agriculture Loan, filling the form and uploading documents, and tracking the application status in real time; the Zia AI assistant can help.

children.title: **2. Visit a Branch or Digital Kiosk**
children.summary: Apply offline by visiting the nearest ZX Bank branch or digital banking kiosk, filling the Agriculture Loan application form, submitting documents for verification, and getting help from dedicated Agri-Loan officers.

children.title: **3. Contact Customer Care**
children.summary: Apply or get help by calling the toll-free Agri Loan helpline 1800-123-4567 or emailing agrihelp@zxbank.asia.

nodes.title: **ZX Bank Supporting Rural Dreams**
nodes.summary: ZX Bank partners with local agri-input suppliers and markets for seamless credit, and provides exclusive SMS alerts, agri-weather tips, and crop advisory with every loan.
